title: fix(components): render a bare-string `collapsible` trigger instead of throwing into the error boundary (objectui#9701)
body:
Fixes #9701

Clause-②: no

⚠️ Angle-bracket-shaped tokens are spelled out in words throughout this body (AGENTS.md, the GitHub-mutates-body-bytes clause). `SchemaNode` arms and JSX element names appear as bare identifiers on purpose.

## The defect, reproduced before it was repaired

An authored `collapsible` whose `trigger` is a **bare string** is accepted by **both published faces** and then fails to render. Reproduced here through the real `SchemaRenderer` and the real registry, on the branch point, **with a firing control in the same run**:

| fixture | reading at the branch point `2923cea16` |
|:--|:--|
| target — `trigger: 'Show more'` | error boundary: `Component "collapsible" failed to render` · `Primitive.button failed to slot onto its children. Expected a single React element child or Slottable` |
| firing control — singular object `trigger: { type: 'button', label: 'Toggle' }` | parses and paints `Toggle`, `data-state="closed"`, toggles open on click |
| control — array `trigger: [ { type: 'button', label: 'Toggle' } ]` | paints, one button, the authored one wearing the Radix trigger props |
| control — bare-string `content` on the same arm | paints; this key never had the defect |

⇒ the target was red while all three controls were green, so the red is about the bare string and not about a broken harness.

## Why it happened

`asChild` resolves the Radix primitive to its `Slot`, which merges its props onto its child by way of `React.Children.only` — a **single React element**, and nothing else. `trigger` is a node slot, and both published faces admit a bare string on it: the TypeScript union `SchemaNode` names `string` explicitly, and the zod mirror types `CollapsibleSchema.trigger` against that same union. So `trigger: 'Show more'` — the most natural thing anyone would write for something called a trigger — validated on both faces, threw at render, and produced no diagnostic naming the key.

## The repair — direction 2, the implementation catching up

`asChild` is now **conditional on Radix's own structural precondition**: the rendered slot being a single React element. Where it is not, the primitive renders its own button around whatever came back, so a string paints as the trigger's text and stays a real, toggling trigger.

The predicate asks Radix's question rather than testing for `string`, so the same refusal that covered the bare string — a **multi-node trigger array** and an **empty slot's null** are that one structural mismatch wearing different values — is answered on every arm at once. An element trigger keeps the merge unchanged, which is asserted as the `ASCHILD_STILL_ON` control rather than assumed.

⛔ **No published face moves**, which is what `Clause-②: no` above declares. `packages/types` is untouched — neither `SchemaNode`, nor `SchemaNodeSchema`, nor the `trigger` union — and the accept set is the one both faces already shipped. The narrowing direction the triage seat named first was ⛔ not taken and is ⛔ not needed: direction 2 proved feasible, which was the first measurement this card asked for.

## After the repair — the same probe, the opposite answer

The bare-string fixture now paints `button type="button" aria-expanded="false" data-state="closed"` carrying the text `Show more`, and toggling it reveals the content. Same document, same harness, error boundary before, painted text after, with the object-trigger control green in **both** runs.

## Ablation of the new pin

Mutated the conditional back to the unconditional `asChild`, from the committed state:

| leg | evidence |
|:--|:--|
| mutation landed | blob `7be440e7` to `562df8f4`, anchor count 1 to 0, injected form 0 to 1, 5712 to 5686 bytes, `git diff --numstat` reads `1 1` |
| pin with the mutation | **exit 1** — one assertion failure (`expected true to be false` on the error-boundary reading), not a load failure; the three controls stayed green |
| restored | `git checkout HEAD --` the absolute path; blob back to `7be440e7` and equal to the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty, 5712 bytes |
| pin after restore | exit 0, 4 passed |

## Gates

Each line is the gate's own printed verdict, taken after the final commit `c90c68d63`.

| gate | exit | printed verdict |
|:--|:--|:--|
| build, dep closure of `@object-ui/components` | 0 | `dist completeness: 1 package(s) complete` for each package built |
| build, `@object-ui/components` | 0 | `built in 14.70s` · `built dist/index.css (155.16 kB)` |
| `type-check` (`tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) | 0 | no diagnostics; the new pin is inside the test program, counted with `--listFiles` (1 hit) against an absent-file control (0 hits) |
| vitest, whole `packages/components` | 0 | `Test Files 279 passed (279)` · `Tests 2733 passed (2733)` |
| `eslint .` in `packages/components` | 0 | `953 problems (0 errors, 953 warnings)` — every warning pre-existing, all in the `ui/` no-touch zone and other untouched files |
| `check-changeset-presence.mjs` | 0 | `1 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)` |
| `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` | 0 | `No changeset declares a major bump` |
| `check-new-cross-file-line-citations.mjs` | 0 | `VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s), enforcement report-only` |

Changeset: `patch` on `@object-ui/components` — a render defect repaired with no declared surface moving.

## `changeset-claim-re-read` — verdict: **no correction owed**

The report-only gate asked whether `.changeset/7767-collapsible-trigger-union.md` goes false because this diff edits the collapsible renderer. **It does not.** Every mechanism that entry asserts was re-derived here against the **merge-base `2923cea165`** and this head `c90c68d63`, each count taken at both revisions. ⚠️ The gate asked for the **paragraph**, not the line, so all **six** of its sentences are answered below, not the ones that mention the edited file:

| the 7767 entry asserts | base | head | verdict |
|:--|:--:|:--:|:--|
| "The Zod mirror is untouched — `zod/disclosure.zod.ts` already spelled this key `z.union([SchemaNodeSchema, z.array(SchemaNodeSchema)])`" | 3 | 3 | still true; that file is **not** among this branch's 3 files |
| "`renderers/disclosure/collapsible.tsx` hands `schema.trigger` to `renderChildren`" | 1 | 1 | still true — the conditional wraps the **result**, it does not replace the call |
| "whose `Array.isArray` branch has served the array form all along" (in `lib/utils.tsx`, where `renderChildren` is **defined**) | 2 | 2 | still true; that file is not in this diff |
| "that same registration's `defaultProps.trigger` ships as an array" | array | array | still true — `trigger: [{ type: 'button', label: 'Toggle', variant: 'outline' }]` |
| "every singular `trigger` keeps type-checking unchanged" / "the TypeScript face stops under-reporting an accept set that already ships" | — | — | still true; `packages/types` contributes **0** files to this diff |
| "The docs page's `trigger` row follows the declaration" | row | row | still true — that page still states the union `SchemaNode` or an array of them, and this diff contributes **0** files under `content/` |

Controls, so the zeros above are readings and not dead instruments: in `lib/utils.tsx` the lit control `renderChildren` reads **4 at both revisions** while an absent token reads **0 at both**; the diff-membership zeros sit beside a file list that is non-empty (3 files).

⚠️ **One nuance stated rather than glossed**, because a reader of the published CHANGELOG will hit it. The 7767 sentence "The Zod mirror is untouched … and so is the runtime" is scoped to **objectui#7767's own diff** — it records that *that* change did not touch them. This PR **does** change that runtime. That does not make the sentence false, because it was never a claim about every future state, and every mechanism it names still holds today.

⚠️ Three probe errors were made reaching this verdict and are recorded so nobody repeats them: diffing against `origin/main` instead of the merge-base returns **10** files including another PR's (this branch is behind main); grepping `Array.isArray` in `collapsible.tsx` returns **0** because the claim attributes that branch to `renderChildren`, which lives elsewhere; and resolving `renderChildren` by taking the first grep hit lands on `packages/components/src/index.ts`, a re-export **barrel**, returning **0** again. Two dead-instrument zeros, one wrong corpus.

## Acceptance notes

- **To file, class (a) — EIGHT sibling renderers carry the identical shape.** ⚠️ The count below is a **measurement with its instrument published**, so it can be reproduced rather than inherited.
  - **Probe.** Corpus: every `.tsx` under `packages/components/src/renderers/` at a given revision, read out of git rather than off a working tree — **195 files** at both revisions. Match: a Radix `*Trigger` element carrying an **unconditional** `asChild` (the attribute with no `=`), whose next non-blank line hands `renderChildren(schema.trigger` — the **authored** slot, not any child. Two regexes, the second searched only within the following three lines.
  - **Reading.** **9** at the merge-base `2923cea165`, **8** at this head `c90c68d63`. The one that left is `collapsible.tsx`, this PR's file.
  - **Lit control, paired on the same instrument and corpus.** The **conditional** spelling (`asChild=` with a brace) over the same slot reads **0 at base and 1 at head**, and the one hit is `collapsible.tsx`. So the probe moves when the repair moves, and the 8 is not a dead-instrument number.
  - **The eight:** `alert-dialog` · `dialog` · `drawer` · `dropdown-menu` · `hover-card` · `popover` · `sheet` · `tooltip`, all under `packages/components/src/renderers/overlay/`.
  - **The declaration half, separately measured.** In `packages/types/src/zod/overlay.zod.ts`, **9 of 9** `trigger` keys are typed `z.union([SchemaNodeSchema, z.array(SchemaNodeSchema)])` — the very union that made the bare string legal here. Controls: the lit control "any `trigger:` key in that file" also reads **9** (so the match is total, not partial), an absent token reads **0**, and the same probe against `disclosure.zod.ts` reads **1**, which is this card's own key. ⚠️ Nine declarations against eight renderers is **not** an inconsistency to round away — it is the gap between the two populations and whoever takes the card should resolve which declaration has no renderer beside it rather than assume a miscount.
  - ⛔ Deliberately **not** repaired in this PR: the claimed file surface on this card is the collapsible renderer alone, each of the eight wants its own pin (a **new** verification surface, so the bounded in-place exemption does not hold), and whether a bare-string trigger is a capability worth having on each of those arms is a per-key reading this card did not take.
  - Dedup terms: `asChild` · `bare string trigger` · `overlay trigger` · `Children.only` · `error boundary`.
- **Noted, not filed — the collapsible root leaks its node slots onto the DOM.** The rendered root carries `trigger="[object Object]"` and `content="[object Object]"` attributes: both keys ride the trailing rest-spread onto the Radix root in addition to being rendered. Pre-existing, cosmetic, and structurally the other half of the exclusion objectui#8236 landed in this same block, so the next PR to touch that spread is the one that will see it. Carrier: whoever revisits that rest-spread. ⛔ Not repaired here — it is not this card's defect class and touching the spread would widen the verification surface.

## Serial constraints

Checked against the two sibling cards in flight: objectui#9606 lands on `packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts` and `packages/types/src/objectql.ts`, objectui#9511 on `packages/types/src/data.ts` and its call sites. This branch touches neither — its whole diff is three files under `packages/components` and `.changeset`. Neither of those two cards is addressed here and both remain open.

Draft on purpose: not ready to land until review.
